description:
1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover the fetch_news.py tool in scripts/. 
2. Agent recognizes the user's 'AI' request requires Smart Keyword Expansion per SKILL.md: must expand 'AI' to at least 3-4 of: AI, LLM, GPT, Claude, Generative, Machine Learning, RAG, Agent — NOT just '--keyword AI'. 
3. Agent uses '--source all' (Global Scan strategy) or multiple sources with broad coverage, AND must include the '--deep' flag since 'deep interpretation' is requested. 
4. Correct invocation example: python3 scripts/fetch_news.py --source all --limit 15 --deep --keyword 'AI,LLM,GPT,Claude,Generative,Machine Learning,RAG,Agent'. 
5. Agent produces a report saved to reports/ with a timestamped filename (the eval finds any *.md in reports/). 
6. Report MUST be in Simplified Chinese. 
7. Every item title MUST be a Markdown link [Title](URL) — not plain text. 
8. Each item needs a metadata line (Source, Time/Date, Heat/Score). 
9. Deep interpretation section with 2-3 bullet points per item is required. 
10. Report structure must include Global Headlines section and Tech & AI section. 
Traps: naive agents will forget --deep, skip keyword expansion, write titles without markdown links, or write in English.
